name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: Marshal Haggard sends you to find Tavernkeep Smitts, who may know the hand behind a page from Stalvan's journal.

sections.title: A Lead from the Marshal
sections.body: Marshal Haggard cannot read the faded writing on the torn journal page you recovered from his chest in Elwynn Forest. His failing eyesight leaves the words beyond him. He recalls serving with the Stormwind Guard and spending evenings at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. So he sends you across the river to Tavernkeep Smitts, whose years behind the bar have made him a keeper of local history and rumors.

sections.title: Return to the Scarlet Raven
sections.body: You cross Duskwood's gloomy woods and show the faded page to Smitts behind the counter. He is glad to hear of his old acquaintance Haggard, though he grieves for the veteran's failing health. Then Smitts sees the parchment, and alarm overtakes his easy manner. He knows the distinctive handwriting without doubt, bringing the search closer to the truth of Stalvan's madness.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Haggard send me back to Darkshire?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard is aging and nearly blind, so he cannot examine the recovered journal page. He remembers Tavernkeep Smitts as a keeper of local lore from his Stormwind Guard days, and sends you to ask him about the writing.
Tavernkeep Smitts tends the bar inside the Scarlet Raven Tavern, on the eastern side of Darkshire in Duskwood.

faq.q: What item do you carry to Tavernkeep Smitts?
faq.answer: You carry a Faded Journal Page, an excerpt from Stalvan Mistmantle's lost journal, found secured inside Marshal Haggard's footlocker.

faq.q: Does Tavernkeep Smitts recognize the handwriting?
faq.answer: Yes. Smitts recognizes the handwriting as soon as he sees the faded page, and his alarm gives the search for Stalvan its next lead.

faq.q: How does Smitts know Marshal Haggard?
faq.answer: Smitts hosted Haggard years ago, when Haggard led Stormwind Guard patrols into Duskwood and visited the Scarlet Raven Tavern for drinks.

faq.q: What comes next in the search for Stalvan?
faq.answer: Take the faded journal page to Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern and follow the lead he gives you.

angles.text: As an Alliance defender, you see bonds between former Stormwind guardsmen and keepers of local history across the Kingdom of Stormwind.
As a human, you see how tragedies in Elwynn and Darkshire remain part of the settlements' memories.
